messages.subject: GGIR in R
parts:
Good afternoon,
I'm using GGIR codes to analyze accelerometer files, and on one hand, when I run the code, it only allows me to analyze a single file, and it says that part 4 of the files is not available. On the other hand, when I use the GPS part to integrate the data, I get this error:
"Error in hbGPS(gps_file = gps_file, outputDir = outputDir, idloc = 2,"
despite having installed everything suggested "install.packages("remotes") remotes::install_github("wadpac/GGIR", force = TRUE) remotes::install_github("habitus-eu/hbGPS", force = TRUE)."
It would be very useful if you could tell me what the solution is.
Best regards and thank you very much.
